verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its own bulk user imports and exports for migrating users into and out of database connections, so bulk operations exist but only for user import/export. The MCP server and CLI are described as automating tasks and multi-step operations, not explicit bulk actions across many items. One community report says exports that include password hashes needed a support ticket, which limits the export side. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond user import/export (e.g., bulk role or permission assignment, bulk updates or deletes), documented bulk actions through the MCP server or CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
